description: Requirement bindings are reviewed contracts, not proof that assertions are behaviorally sufficient. Implemented fixtures remain bounded by their declared scope. Deferred functional cases are not human gates.

lifecycle-calibration.scope: Owned runner lifecycle and real Arrow; no gameplay acceptance.

deliberate-failure.scope: Intentional failed assertion control; expected negative runner result.

foundation-contracts.scope: Immutable production DTO consumers on Paper with synthetic inputs.

protocol-player-calibration.scope: Actual offline protocol join/slot/bow/quit, not feature equipment or dragon damage.

item-identity.scope: Real ItemStack/PDC serialization and production item-to-snapshot projection; no player events.

stats-resolution.scope: Production numeric resolver with synthetic inputs; no player equipment.

projectile-feasibility.scope: Shooterless physical Arrow/dragon observations only; partial T04.

projectile-cleanup-failure.scope: Intentional scenario exception and owned listener/entity/task/chunk cleanup.

projectile-cleanup-abort.scope: Direct context abort and cleanup; not a plugin unload.

combat-accounting.scope: Production combat services with synthetic physical inputs; no native damage adapter.

equipment-stats.scope: Production equipment service/codec with real item bytes and synthetic UUID/sender; no player-event claim.

equipment-player.scope: Real offline protocol player/held/bow/quit plus public API command, permission, inventory edit, death/respawn fixtures; captured actual client messages. No visuals/authentication claim.

protocol-player-soak.scope: Actual offline player remains connected through a 40-second monotonic delay after native flight; keepalive and bounded real quit/cleanup, not a general load benchmark.

projectile-player-feasibility.scope: Real protocol bow release and API-spawned player-owned native arrows against real dragons; bounded phase/geometry and suppression observations, no production adapter or semantic head identifier.

headless-player-primitives.scope: Two real offline protocol identities, bounded typed actions, real Paper acceptance/cancellation, native damage health observations, deployed stats API, respawn/reconnect and cleanup. No production dragon adapter or account/visual acceptance.

headless-player-cleanup-abort.scope: Intended companion abort with two connected real actors, executed commands and live owned permissions/blocks/entity/task. Requires graceful client closure and exact resource restoration.

same-profile-restart.scope: Generic two-boot starter config and connected command calibration; not managed dragon recovery.

same-profile-restart-abort.scope: Generic two-boot starter config and connected command calibration; not managed dragon recovery.

enchants-procs.scope: Production proc coordinator on actual Paper scheduler ticks with synthetic settled impacts/session tokens, plus real item serialization through stats/effects/combat. No physical firing, Duplex emission or player-listener P08/P09 acceptance.

dragon-definitions.scope: Production dragon loader/registry/bootstrap with synthetic candidates on Paper; immutable revision retention and inert bindings. No live dragon, player, reward policy or grant acceptance.

dragon-definitions-abort.scope: Intended abort after deployed production catalog mutation; owned cleanup restores original catalog and verifies full resolved values before releasing resources.

owned-firing.scope: Two real protocol identities exercise deployed T06 native draw, shortbow/hold, Duplex, captured sessions, ammo/cancellation, actual dragon part/phase settlement and terminal cleanup. Uniform 1.0 part policy; no semantic head or T08 HP/proc/score accounting claim.

practice-combat.scope: Two actual protocol actors through production practice commands, physical/proc accounting and independent native HP/event/numeric expectations; calibration only, no human or dragon acceptance.

practice-lifecycle.scope: Two actual actors, retained real projectile across reconnect, queued proc death/quit/exit, replacement generations, proc-lethal and pending competing physical claims; server flight hold and death are explicit fixture setup.

tracer-continuity.scope: T07 production native-arrow Tracer/continuity, controlled real-dragon positions, obstacles, age boundary and cleanup; no ritual or human visuals.

tracer-cleanup-abort.scope: Deliberate abort with live production shared ticket demand and service cleanup.

dragon-combat.scope: Production managed dragon commands, lifecycle and immutable accounting on pinned Paper; offline actor, no authentication/visual/prefire acceptance.

dragon-restart-fresh.scope: Production managed dragon commands, lifecycle and immutable accounting on pinned Paper; offline actor, no authentication/visual/prefire acceptance.

dragon-restart-legacy.scope: Production managed dragon commands, lifecycle and immutable accounting on pinned Paper; offline actor, no authentication/visual/prefire acceptance.

dragon-restart-animation.scope: Production shutdown during actual owned-arrow native death animation, followed by loaded old-chunk UUID absence and new generation controls; no simulated disable.

dragon-ranking.scope: Two real offline protocol identities: production owned-arrow death, frozen ranking, reconnect, proc lethal, diagnostic/no-board controls and received messages.

tempo-ghost.scope: Actual native bow and physical Duplex impacts, captured FT swap, global buff/expiry, full credit and level V HP, training/default/calibration selections and frozen result/reset. Other levels and queue/lifecycle boundaries have production JUnit controls.

dragon-presentation.scope: Two received UI identities with actual owned-arrow HP, ghost-only proc credit, native death/removal, reconnect/world transfer/reset/close and formatted commands/results.

contract-consumers.description: Immutable shared DTO behavior, revisions and bounded ancestry.

runner-lifecycle.description: Real pinned Paper lifecycle and native Arrow with cleanup.

runner-negative.description: Deliberate assertion failure must fail the runner.

protocol-input.description: Real protocol player join, selected-slot, bow use/release, native shooter, quit and early-exit/timeout controls.

stats-resolver.description: Production resolver numeric order, raw/effective values and source replacement.

item-codec.description: Production identity/edit validation and real serialized item-to-snapshot values.

projectile-observations.description: Partial shooterless collision, phase, simultaneous and pre-spawn observations; not player-owned native damage.

projectile-player-observations.description: Player-owned native-positive and cancellation/zero controls, actual part geometry, HOVER/CIRCLING/seated observations and three same-tick impacts; paired cleanup. Feature early-exit is a separate standalone control; shared protocol negatives remain in the suite.

projectile-impact-policy.description: Independent review of the measured single physical-impact authority and native-suppression boundary, uniform managed part scale 1.0 without a semantic-head claim, initially supported HOVER/CIRCLING/SEARCH_FOR_BREATH_ATTACK_TARGET phases and explicit rejection of unmeasured phases by the later production adapter. Record the scoped design decision separately from automated observation evidence.

listener-cleanup.description: Scenario-owned listener/resource cleanup on exception and direct context abort.

combat-services.description: Production combat accounting, duplicate/lifecycle rejection, caps and separate health/score.

suite-baseline.description: Fresh full registered regression and expected-failure baseline on exact clean source inputs.

equipment-service.description: Production equipment cache, main-hand provenance, same-UUID edit refresh and command boundaries.

equipment-player.description: Actual protocol player equipment/held events, grant permissions, refresh and quit cleanup; synthetic UUIDs or command sender proxies cannot satisfy this.

bounded-procs.description: Bounded production ferocity queue, inherited damage/crit, observable admission rejection, Tempo expiry/captured swap eligibility, item-to-effects regression and scheduler/session/target cleanup. Physical firing integration remains P08/P09.

firing-input.description: Actual player bow/shortbow trigger/cadence, immutable shot ownership and ammo/cancellation behavior.

P01.description: Real owned Arrow into a managed dummy: one physical impact/ledger entry and no native double damage.

P02.description: Production managed arrow/dragon adapter: actual part-to-parent mapping, uniform 1.0 scaling under reviewed T04 policy, idempotent claim and native suppression; no semantic head identifier claimed.

P03.description: Several real eligible projectiles on one tick: each counted once through the production adapter without hurt-window loss.

P04.description: Production adapter enforces reviewed HOVER/CIRCLING/SEARCH_FOR_BREATH_ATTACK_TARGET admission and explicit unsupported-phase rejection. Natural-End-cycle/all-phase coverage remains pending automation.

P05.description: Production countdown/hatch: launch before hatch before physical impact with continuous projectile UUID.

P06.description: Early/late/off-angle/obstructed shots produce real misses, without phantom damage.

P07.description: All Dragon Tracer levels and moving targets respect acquisition/steering boundaries.

P08.description: Physical Duplex plus bounded ferocity integration produces correct counts/scales without recursion.

P09.description: Actual two-bow Fatal Tempo/Duplex swap preserves captured ownership and expiry eligibility.

P10.description: Accepted production projectile ageing/chunk-boundary lifecycle with bounded ticket ownership.

P11.description: Production death/reset/disconnect/shutdown: one completion, no late score and no retained owned resources.

P12.description: Representative volleys/load: measured tick, memory, queue/projectile and repeated-cleanup envelope.

P13.description: Actual cancelled launch/hit in the production adapter grants no damage or duplicate ammunition consumption.

P14.description: Production configuration revision adoption leaves airborne shots unchanged and updates only subsequent encounters.

eye-transactions.description: Concurrent placements and restart/refund recovery prevent duplicated eyes or encounters.

durable-progression.description: Durable reward/grant identity and bounded acquisition rules survive replay/restart.

runner-unit-checks.description: CI must execute Python report-validator and failure-contract tests without failures or skips.

bridge-unit-checks.description: CI must execute Symphony bridge protocol/sandbox tests; required MCP/skills startup evidence remains separately recorded.

checkpoint-unit-checks.description: CI must exercise checkpoint false-green, DAG, coverage, stale and missing receipt regressions.

human-input-feel.description: Human mouse/hold cadence and subjective usability evidence.

human-prefire-visuals.description: Human visual hatch cue/prefire timing rehearsal.

authenticated-multiplayer.description: Actual authenticated multiple-player ownership and interaction evidence.

roster-acquisition-scope.description: User decision for the bounded variant roster, rewards and acquisition scope.

dragon-definition-catalog.description: One production test-dragon/versioned definition registry: atomic validation, stable retained revisions and explicit type isolation on real Paper. Additional type fixtures are calibration-only.

sample-loot-table-bindings.description: Inert versioned sample table/item references validate without reward calculation, grant enabling or inventory mutation; no real product drop values approved.

managed-dragon-development.description: Shared T08 lifecycle plus T06 physical claims on a real managed test dragon: supported phase/native damage boundary, one completion, permission-gated controls, reset/failure cleanup and no real rewards.

frozen-damage-ranking.description: Post-kill unique ranking by frozen credited damage including reduced/zero-HP procs and lethal overkill, excluding post-death impacts. Compare total descending, then receiver commit tick of last strict represented-total increase and encounter-global monotonic committed accepted-impact ordinal. Zero-only existing combat participants instead use immutable first-successful-participation tick/ordinal after positive totals; repeated zeros cannot move it and zero-to-positive selects the credit stamp without choosing loot eligibility. Require complete production provenance, no backdated-input influence, unchanged-total and transitivity controls plus actual multi-identity Paper presentation.

personal-loot-preview.description: Deterministic personal rank-based simulations with hard item exclusion, visible calibration provenance and actual no-grant side effects. Real rewards always disabled; cannot be enabled by configuration or command.

headless-player-primitives.description: Reusable typed real-player commands, movement, look, hands, block/entity interaction, drop, bow, respawn and reconnect with exact action plans and independently observed Paper effects.

headless-damage-primitives.description: Reusable real event observation of initial/settled/final damage, cancellation, actor/target identity and post-tick health cohorts. Native calibration is distinct from production physical accounting.

offline-paper-bootstrap.description: Checksum-verified fresh-profile bootstrap from the pinned Paper and its embedded Mojang metadata, exercised by actual Paper startup and independently replayed artifact hashes.

automated-multiplayer-firing.description: At least two real protocol player identities exercise production firing, immutable shot/weapon ownership, registry isolation, simultaneous physical claims, cancellation/ammo accounting and owned cleanup. Observe each actual projectile and its owner through the T06 boundary; generic fixture calibration is insufficient. Full combat/proc HP and ghost-score accounting remains the separate T08/M3 attribution requirement.

automated-multiplayer-attribution.description: At least two real protocol player identities exercise the production physical/proc accounting path, swaps, cancellation, same-tick and lethal ordering; exact accepted HP and ghost score are independently expected. Generic fixture calibration is insufficient.

same-profile-restart.description: Fixed two-boot shared-profile config continuity, phase provenance and intended abort cleanup; no managed dragon proof.

dragon-bossbar.description: Authoritative domain HP/max/percent in one owned received boss bar per managed dragon generation, with two-player visibility and all lifecycle cleanup; credited/ghost damage never drives bar health.

combat-presentation.description: Readable shared stat/combat/leaderboard formatting with exact numerical/recipient/permission semantics and machine diagnostics preserved; actual received output plus component-style checks.

bounded-dragon-flight.description: Versioned public-API native dragon motion and actual multipart containment within explicit arena margins, supported phases and lifecycle/ticket cleanup; stationary calibration remains available.

moving-dragon-tracer.description: Real moving-target Tracer flight, native physical collision and original pre-spawn projectile identity under a separately reviewed v2 profile; unenchanted/blocked/out-of-range controls and received motion evidence.

fatal-tempo-ghost-scaling.description: Versioned player-wide Tempo/Ferocity with independent eligible impact rolls; active level HP shares100/90/80/70/60/50 percent for none/I/II/III/IV/V and full100percent credit. Separate active policy provenance from captured refresh eligibility, preserve legacy profiles and verify levels/expiry/mixed-order/swaps/lethal/late physical results.

expanded-bow-enchantments.description: Named Overload and Gravity profiles, trusted levels/compatibility and captured/inherited decisions; deterministic boundaries and actual managed physical HP/credit/provenance with no unresolved effect advertised as active.

held-shortbow-loadouts.description: Actual repeated firing while held with shared attack-speed cadence, explicit drawn/instant loadouts, separate ultimate combinations and stop/cancellation/ammo/moving-Tracer controls. Received help and lore explain the selected profile.

enchant-books-anvil.description: Ten validated custom enchanted-book types and XP-cost application through real placed anvils, exact-once consumption/metadata preservation and effective equipped behavior. Invalid/denied/stale/close/shift paths conserve resources; armor architecture only.

quiver-flame-integration.description: Captured Infinite Quiver ammo chance through the existing reservation/refund authority and bounded owned Flame DOT through existing HP/credit/defeat authority, including immunity/refresh/expiry/multiowner/terminal/no-recursion controls.
